svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Five strips per stage: 171, 167, 167, 167 and 171 mm wide.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut from a 1.0 x 1.4 m piece; the views show the part that lies

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under the plate, from the high wall's outside face to the brine tail.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Low end: follow the plate's zigzag 13 mm inside it (10 mm dry

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: break), then a 30 mm wide tail along the middle of the brine

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tongue, as long as the tongue (plus 10 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: High end: leave 150 mm extra beyond the plate's high edge for

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the feed tail (out through the opening, up the wall, into the trough).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hold it under the plate with two stainless clips and no adhesive:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a high-end clip (SSK-DWG-119) at the plate's high edge and a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tongue clip over the brine tongue and the tail (SSK-DWG-120).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The strip edges stay 10 mm from the ribs and rails (dry breaks).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no fibre bridges a dry break; tail centred on its tongue.
